welcome.title: Code with AI that never leaves your computer.
welcome.body: No account and no telemetry. Ylide only goes online to update its model list, to check for updates and for downloads you start yourself. You can switch each of these off later.
welcome.hint: The scan reads your graphics card, memory and processor. Nothing is sent.

scan.title: What this computer can run
scan.lead: Models need fast memory. Ylide measures graphics memory, system memory, processor and disk space to find one that fits.
scan.asideBody: Ylide reads them on this computer and only uses them to choose a model that fits. Nothing is sent.
scan.noGpuBody: Models run on the processor. That works, but answers come more slowly.
scan.diskUnknown: The free space could not be determined.
scan.software: Software renderer, not used for models

model.title: A model for this computer
model.lead: Chosen from the measured memory and speed. You can switch models at any time later.
model.failed: No recommendation could be worked out. {{error}}

spec.noSpace: larger than the free disk space ({{free}} GB)

license.restricted: {{name}}: check the terms before commercial use

diff.qualityHint: Curated score for agentic coding, from 0 to 100

runtime.label: Download NVIDIA acceleration (CUDA, {{size}})
runtime.body: Vulkan works without it. This is an extra download from GitHub, checked against its checksum.

own.title: Use your own model
own.body: Already have a GGUF file, such as a fine-tune or a model from Hugging Face? Ylide uses it as it is, without a download.

model.importFailed: The file could not be imported
model.nothingBody: You can still use a GGUF file you already have, or connect a server such as Ollama or LM Studio.

external.title: Connect an existing server
external.body: Ylide works with any OpenAI-compatible server, such as Ollama, LM Studio or another llama-server.
external.invalidUrl: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
external.modelHint: Needed for Ollama and LM Studio. Leave empty for llama-server.
external.modelRequired: {{server}} needs a model name, for example qwen3:8b.
external.apiKeyHint: Only if the server asks for one.
external.remote: This server is not on this computer. Your prompts and code are sent to {{host}}.

download.title: Downloading
download.lead: Ylide checks every file against its SHA-256 checksum before using it. You can pause and continue later.
download.leadDone: Every file matched its SHA-256 checksum and is ready to use.
download.note: If you close Ylide, the part already downloaded is kept and the download resumes from there.
download.confirmBody: The partly downloaded file is deleted. You can start the download again at any time.
download.cancelled: The download was cancelled. Start it again to continue.
download.allowModel: Allow model downloads and try again
download.allowRuntime: Allow runtime downloads and try again

ready.lead: Chat, edits and agents now run on this computer.
ready.leadExternal: Chat, edits and agents use the server at {{host}}.
ready.background: You can open a folder now. The model keeps loading in the background.
ready.stoppedBody: The model stopped. Start it again or choose another one.

tip.chat: Ask the chat about your code
tip.inline: Edit the selected code with AI
tip.agents: Let agents work on a task
